finalText:
Migrated all 12 files still on `db.query` over to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — 36 call sites in total, each a get-by-id, list, or update. Left `cache.query` and the vendored `legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone since they're not part of this migration.

The verify script confirms it: no `db.query` left in `packages/`, every `db.execute` call carries both `sql` and `params`, and all the modules still load and run correctly.
